name: fresh-news feedback OFF (control)
description: Control arm for the Paper B headline: identical to fresh_news_feedback_on.json in every respect except feedback=false and a separate results folder.
notes: This is the arm the study has never had. Every one of the 90 legacy runs had
feedback ON, so the self-reflection claim was untestable.
EVERY option below must match fresh_news_feedback_on.json except 'feedback' and
'results_subdir'. If you change the gate, the cadence, the order mode or the
screening in one arm, change it in BOTH or the paired test is meaningless.
Runs land in results/portfolio_sim/feedback_off/ and are tagged '_fboff' in the
filename, so the two arms can never be confused even if they share a folder.
After both arms finish: python analyze_feedback.py
